## Age and Gender

### Age distribution

```{r age_group, include = F}
# Calculate age group counts and percentages
age_count <- df %>%
  count(age_group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage),
    label = pct_label,
    label_color = if_else(percentage >= 15, "white", "black")
  )

# Total number of surgeons
total_age_n <- sum(age_count$n, na.rm = TRUE)

# Graph barplot
age_group_bar <- age_count %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_group,
    y = n,
    fill = n
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label, color = label_color),
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    direction = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age Groups",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Number of Surgeons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

### Participant Characteristic Table

```{r}
# Section one (header)
.build_section <- function(df, var, section_label, digits = 1,
                           include_na_row = FALSE, na_label = "Not reported/applicable") {
  v <- df[[var]]

  # normalize to character; treat blanks as NA
  v_chr <- if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else as.character(v)
  v_chr <- ifelse(str_trim(v_chr) == "", NA_character_, v_chr)

  # denominator: non-missing values in this section
  denom <- sum(!is.na(v_chr))

  # counts for non-missing
  items <- tibble(value = v_chr)  %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    count(value, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n), value) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = n / denom,
      display = sprintf("%s (%s)", n, percent(pct, accuracy = 10^-digits)),
      row_type = "item",
      label = as.character(value)
    ) %>%
    select(row_type, label, display)

  # optional NA row (excluded from denominator)
  if (include_na_row && any(is.na(v_chr))) {
    na_n <- sum(is.na(v_chr))
    items <- bind_rows(
      items,
      tibble(
        row_type = "item",
        label = na_label,
        display = sprintf("%s (%s)", na_n, percent(na_n / (denom + na_n), accuracy = 10^-digits))
      )
    )
  }

  # section header row
  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    label    = sprintf("%s, n (%%)", section_label),
    display  = sprintf("N = %s studies", comma(denom))
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}

# ----- Build the whole profile table 
make_profile_table_gt <- function(
  df,
  sections = c(
    age_group             = "Age Group",
    gender                = "Gender",
    country_practice      = "Country of Practice"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,      # set TRUE if you want an explicit NA row per section
  title = "Participant demographics",# table title (left)
  overall_n_right = TRUE       # show overall N on the far right of the table title
) {
  # assemble all sections (stacked)
  body <- map2_dfr(names(sections), unname(sections), ~
    .build_section(df, var = .x, section_label = .y, digits = digits, include_na_row = include_na_row)
  )

  # little helper for visual indent
  body <- body %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(row_type == "item", paste0("  ", label), label),
      `n (%)` = display
    ) %>%
    select(Label, `n (%)`, row_type)

  # overall N (optional, in the title area)
  overall_tag <- if (overall_n_right) paste0("N = ", scales::comma(nrow(df)), " studies") else NULL

  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(title),
      subtitle = overall_tag
    ) %>%
    # style section header rows
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cell_text(align = "right")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "n (%)")
    ) %>%
    # add subtle indentation to item rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "item", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    # thin row separators between sections
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    ) %>%
    # draw a light rule above each new section
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "grey85", weight = px(1))),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%
    cols_label(Label = md(""), `n (%)` = md(""))

  gt_tbl
}

# Make table using gt 
gt_table <- make_profile_table_gt(
  df,
  sections = c(
    # add more or reorder as you like:
    age_group             = "Patients (age groups)",
    gender                = "Patients Gender",
    country_practice      = "Country of Practice"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,
  title = "Participant Characteristics",
  overall_n_right = TRUE
)

gt_table
```

### Demographic Pyramid

```{r demo_pyramid include=F}
# Calculate counts and percentages by age group and gender
pyramid_data <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(age_group),
    !is.na(gender),
    gender %in% c("Male", "Female")
  ) %>%
  count(age_group, gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n),
    plot_n = if_else(
      gender == "Male",
      -n,
      n
    ),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage)
  )

# Create demographic pyramid
demographic_pyramid <- pyramid_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_group,
    y = plot_n,
    fill = gender
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = pct_label,
      hjust = if_else(plot_n < 0, 1.1, -0.1)
    ),
    size = 5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) abs(x),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "darkred",
      "Female" = "orange"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Age and Gender Distribution of Surgeons",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Number of Surgeons",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

## Country of practice

### Prep country data

```{r prep_country_practice include=F}
# View the countries
# unique(df$country_currently)
# unique(df$country_practice)

# Extract unique countries from each column
clean_country_practice <- df %>% 
  separate_rows(country_currently, sep = ";") %>% 
  mutate(country_currently = str_trim(country_currently))

# Build a vector of valid country names using the countrycode package
valid_countries <- unique(countrycode::codelist$country.name.en)  # Standard country name

# Count respondents by country
country_counts <- clean_country_practice %>% 
  mutate(
    iso_a3 = case_when(
      country_currently == "cote_divoire" ~ "CIV",
      country_currently == "democratic_republic_of_the_congo" ~ "COD",
      TRUE ~ countrycode(
        str_replace_all(country_currently, "_", " "),
        origin = "country.name",
        destination = "iso3c"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(iso_a3)) %>%
  count(country_currently, iso_a3, name = "country_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(country_count))

# Retrieve African country boundaries
africa <- ne_countries(
  continent = "Africa",
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

# Join survey counts to map
africa_data <- africa %>%
  left_join(
    country_counts,
    by = c("adm0_a3" = "iso_a3")
  )

```

### Create Top 5 Countries Barplot

```{r coutry_plot include=F}
# Calculate total number of country counts
total_n <- sum(country_counts$country_count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create the count table 
bar_df_top5 <- country_counts %>%
  arrange(desc(country_count), iso_a3) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage  = 100 * country_count / total_n,
    pct_label   = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage),
    # choose label color based on how dark the bar will be
    label_color = if_else(percentage >= 12, "white", "black")  # tweak threshold if needed
  )

barplot_choro <- bar_df_top5 %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(country_currently, percentage),
    y = percentage, fill = percentage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  # place text just inside the right edge; color varies by bar brightness
  geom_text(aes(label = pct_label, color = label_color),
            hjust = 0.98, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")) +
  scale_color_identity() +  # use the colors already in the data
  scale_x_discrete(
  labels = stringr::str_to_title) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Contributors to Total PRS") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
    axis.title  = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",                 # <-- anchor to plot left edge
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6))
  )

barplot_choro
```

### Create Choropleth

```{r choropleth include=F}

    data = africa,

    legend.position = "top",

    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
```

## Years in Practice

### Histogram

```{r yrs_practice include=F}
# Prep data
practice_df <- df %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(year_prs_accredited),
    year_prs_accredited >= 0,
    year_prs_accredited < 50
  )

# Calculate median
median_practice <- median(practice_df$year_prs_accredited)

# Create histogram of years in practice
yrs_practice <- practice_df %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year_prs_accredited,
    fill = after_stat(count)
    )) +
    
  # Histogram
  geom_histogram(
    aes(fill = after_stat(count)),
    binwidth = 1,
    boundary = 0,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
    
  # Kernel density curve
  geom_density(
    aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 1)),
    color = "grey",
    linewidth = 0.75,
    adjust = 1,
    fill = NA
  )  +
  
  # Median years
  geom_vline(
  xintercept = median(
   df$year_prs_accredited,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  linetype = "dashed",
  color = "#C0392B",
  linewidth = 0.8
 ) +
    
  # Frequency labels above bars
  geom_text(
  stat = "bin",
  binwidth = 1,
  boundary = 0,
  aes(label = ifelse(
    after_stat(count) > 0,
    paste0("n = ", after_stat(count)),
    "")),
  vjust = -1,
  size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    direction = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Years Since Specialty Accreditation",
    x = "Years Since Specialty Accreditation",
    y = "Number of Surgeons",
    caption = paste0(
      "Grey solid curve: kernel density estimate (scaled to frequency). ",
      "Red dashed line: median (",
      round(median_practice, 1),
      " years)."
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,25, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20, by = 5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4)
  )
```

## Professional Training Background

```{r professional_table include=F}
# Group specialty accreditation years
training_df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    accreditation_year_group = case_when(
      as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)) < 2000 ~ "Pre-2000",
      between(as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)), 2000, 2009) ~ "2000-2009",
      between(as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)), 2010, 2019) ~ "2010-2019",
      as.numeric(as.character(accreditation_year)) >= 2020 ~ "2020+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    accreditation_year_group = factor(
      accreditation_year_group,
      levels = c(
        "Pre-2000",
        "2000-2009",
        "2010-2019",
        "2020+"
      )
    )
  )

# Build individual sections
.build_training_section <- function(
  df,
  var,
  section_label,
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE
) {

  v <- as.character(df[[var]])
  v <- na_if(str_trim(v), "")

  denom <- sum(!is.na(v))

  items <- tibble(value = v) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  count(value, name = "N") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * N / denom, digits),
    row_type = "item",
    Label = value
  ) %>%
  select(row_type, Label, N, Percent)

  # Sort accreditation years chronologically
  if (var == "accreditation_year_group") {
    items <- items %>%
      arrange(match(
        Label,
        c("Pre-2000", "2000-2009", "2010-2019", "2020+")
      ))
  } else {
    items <- items %>%
      arrange(desc(N), Label)
  }

  # Optional missing-value row
  if (include_na_row && any(is.na(v))) {
    na_n <- sum(is.na(v))

    items <- bind_rows(
      items,
      tibble(
        row_type = "item",
        Label = "Not reported/applicable",
        N = na_n,
        Percent = round(100 * na_n / length(v), digits)
      )
    )
  }

  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    Label = section_label,
    N = denom,
    Percent = NA_real_
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}


# Build complete professional training table
make_training_table_gt <- function(
  df,
  sections = c(
    qualification = "Highest Qualification",
    accreditation_body = "Primary Accreditation Body",
    accreditation_year_group = "Year of Specialty Accreditation"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,
  title = "Professional Training Background"
) {

  body <- map2_dfr(
    names(sections),
    unname(sections),
    ~ .build_training_section(
      df,
      var = .x,
      section_label = .y,
      digits = digits,
      include_na_row = include_na_row
    )
  )

  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(paste0("**", title, "**")),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Total sample: N = ",
        scales::comma(nrow(df))
      )
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      Label = "Characteristic",
      N = "N",
      Percent = "%"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = Percent,
      decimals = digits
    ) %>%
    sub_missing(
      columns = Percent,
      missing_text = ""
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = N,
      decimals = 0,
      use_seps = TRUE
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "section"
      )
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "item",
        columns = Label
      )
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(
        sides = "top",
        color = "grey85",
        weight = px(1)
      ),
      locations = cells_body(
        rows = row_type == "section"
      )
    ) %>%
    cols_align(
      align = "right",
      columns = c(N, Percent)
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    )

  gt_tbl
}
```

```{r barplot_function include=F}
# Reusable bar plot function
create_barplot <- function(data, variable, title) {
  
  data %>% 
    count({{variable}}) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(
      x = {{variable}},
      y = n,
      fill = n
    )) + 
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3
      ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd",
      direction = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title, 
      x = NULL, 
      y = "Number of Surgeons"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r facility_table include=F}
# Section one (header)
.build_section <- function(df, var, section_label, digits = 1,
                           include_na_row = FALSE, na_label = "Not reported/applicable") {
  v <- df[[var]]

  # normalize to character; treat blanks as NA
  v_chr <- if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else as.character(v)
  v_chr <- ifelse(str_trim(v_chr) == "", NA_character_, v_chr)

  # denominator: non-missing values in this section
  denom <- sum(!is.na(v_chr))

  # counts for non-missing
  items <- tibble(value = v_chr)  %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    count(value, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n), value) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = n / denom,
      display = sprintf("%s (%s)", n, percent(pct, accuracy = 10^-digits)),
      row_type = "item",
      label = as.character(value)
    ) %>%
    select(row_type, label, display)

  # optional NA row (excluded from denominator)
  if (include_na_row && any(is.na(v_chr))) {
    na_n <- sum(is.na(v_chr))
    items <- bind_rows(
      items,
      tibble(
        row_type = "item",
        label = na_label,
        display = sprintf("%s (%s)", na_n, percent(na_n / (denom + na_n), accuracy = 10^-digits))
      )
    )
  }

  # section header row
  header <- tibble(
    row_type = "section",
    label    = sprintf("%s, n (%%)", section_label),
    display = sprintf("N = %s facilities", comma(denom))
  )

  bind_rows(header, items)
}

# ----- Build the whole profile table 
make_facility_gt <- function(
  df,
  sections = c(
    facility_location_type             = "Urban vs. Rural",
    facility_level                = "Level of Health Facility",
    facility_ownership      = "Facility Ownership Type"
  ),
  digits = 1,
  include_na_row = FALSE,      # set TRUE if you want an explicit NA row per section
  title = "Facility Characteristics",# table title (left)
  overall_n_right = TRUE       # show overall N on the far right of the table title
) {
  # assemble all sections (stacked)
  body <- map2_dfr(names(sections), unname(sections), ~
    .build_section(df, var = .x, section_label = .y, digits = digits, include_na_row = include_na_row)
  )

  # little helper for visual indent
  body <- body %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(row_type == "item", paste0("  ", label), label),
      `n (%)` = display
    ) %>%
    select(Label, `n (%)`, row_type)

  # overall N (optional, in the title area)
  overall_tag <- if (overall_n_right) {
  paste0("N = ", scales::comma(nrow(df)), " facilities")
} else {
  NULL
}
  gt_tbl <- body %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_hide(columns = row_type) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(title),
      subtitle = overall_tag
    ) %>%
    # style section header rows
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cell_text(align = "right")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section", columns = "n (%)")
    ) %>%
    # add subtle indentation to item rows
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(12)),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "item", columns = "Label")
    ) %>%
    # thin row separators between sections
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(13),
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      table.border.top.color = "grey70",
      table.border.top.width = px(1),
      table.border.bottom.color = "grey70",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(1)
    ) %>%
    # draw a light rule above each new section
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "grey85", weight = px(1))),
      locations = cells_body(rows = row_type == "section")
    ) %>%
    cols_label(Label = md(""), `n (%)` = md(""))

  gt_tbl
}
```

```{r}
# Create function
format_staffing <- function(x) {

  # Remove missing values
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  # If all values are missing
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NR")

  # If only one respondent reported a value
  if (length(x) == 1) {
    return(as.character(x))
  }

  # If multiple respondents reported values
  median_value <- median(x)
  min_value <- min(x)
  max_value <- max(x)

  # If all respondents agree, show only the value
  if (min_value == max_value) {
    return(as.character(median_value))
  }

  # Otherwise, show median (minimum–maximum)
  paste0(
    median_value,
    " (", min_value, "–", max_value, ")"
  )
}

# Facility-level staffing summary
facility_staffing <- merged_df %>%
  group_by(facility_country, facility_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_respondents = n(),

    prs_surgeons = format_staffing(num_prs_surgeons),
    prs_trainees = format_staffing(num_prs_trainees),
    ot_nurses = format_staffing(num_ot_nurses),
    physiotherapists = format_staffing(num_physiotherapists),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(facility_country, facility_name)

# Create table grouped by country
facility_staffing %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "facility_country") %>%
  cols_label(
    facility_name = "Facility",
    n_respondents = "Respondents (n)",
    prs_surgeons = "PRS surgeons",
    prs_trainees = "PRS trainees",
    ot_nurses = "OT nurses",
    physiotherapists = "Physiotherapists"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Reported Surgical Workforce by Facility and Country",
    subtitle = "Facility-level workforce estimates"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -facility_name
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(5),
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = paste(
      "For facilities with multiple valid reports,",
      "values represent median (minimum–maximum).",
      "For facilities with one valid report,",
```

```{r}
facility_emergency <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    emergency_24hr = na_if(str_trim(as.character(emergency_24hr)), "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_country, facility_name) %>%
  summarise(
    facility_level = first(na.omit(facility_level),
                           default = NA_character_),

    facility_location_type = first(
      na.omit(facility_location_type),
      default = NA_character_
    ),

    emergency_coverage = case_when(
      all(is.na(emergency_24hr)) ~ NA_character_,
      n_distinct(emergency_24hr, na.rm = TRUE) > 1 ~ "Conflicting",
      TRUE ~ first(na.omit(emergency_24hr))
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Keep facilities with valid Yes/No responses
emergency_df <- facility_emergency %>%
  filter(emergency_coverage %in% c("Yes", "No"))

# Function to calculate N (%)
summarize_coverage <- function(data, group_var, group_label) {

  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]])) %>%
    group_by(
      group = .data[[group_var]],
      emergency_coverage
    ) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(
      group,
      emergency_coverage = c("Yes", "No"),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct),
      column = paste(group_label, group)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(emergency_coverage, column, value)
}

overall <- emergency_df %>%
  count(emergency_coverage, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    emergency_coverage = c("Yes", "No"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
    value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct),
    column = "Overall"
  ) %>%
  select(emergency_coverage, column, value)

by_level <- summarize_coverage(
  emergency_df,
  "facility_level",
  "Level:"
)

by_location <- summarize_coverage(
  emergency_df,
  "facility_location_type",
  "Location:"
)

table_5_2 <- bind_rows(
  overall,
  by_level,
  by_location
) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = column,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    emergency_coverage = factor(
      emergency_coverage,
      levels = c("Yes", "No")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(emergency_coverage) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 5.2. Emergency PRS Coverage**"),
    subtitle = "Overall and by facility characteristics"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    emergency_coverage = "Emergency PRS Coverage"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -emergency_coverage
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    md(
      "*Values are n (%). Percentages are calculated within each group. Facilities with unresolved or missing Q28 responses are excluded.*"
    )
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping()

table_5_2
```

# SERVICE DELIVERY

## Scope of Procedure Performed

### Heatmap

```{r heatmap include=F}
# Create list of variables
procedure_vars <- names(df)[84:101]

response_levels <- c(
  "routinely",
  "occasionally",
  "rarely",
  "not_performed"
)

# Custom procedure labels
procedure_labels <- c(
  "wound_debridement"     = "Wound Debridement",
  "skin_lesion_excision"  = "Skin Lesion Excision",
  "burn_excision"         = "Burn Excision",
  "burn_reconstruction"   = "Burn Reconstruction",
  "contracture_release"   = "Contracture Release",
  "skin_substitute_app"   = "Skin Substitute Application",
  "stsg"                  = "Split-Thickness Skin Graft",
  "ftsg"                  = "Full-Thickness Skin Graft",
  "local_pedicled_flaps"  = "Local/Pedicled Flaps",
  "microvascular_surgery" = "Microvascular Surgery",
  "hand_surgery_proc"     = "Hand Surgery Procedures",
  "tendon_repair"         = "Tendon Repair",
  "amputation"            = "Amputation",
  "cleft_lip_repair"      = "Cleft Lip Repair",
  "cleft_palate_repair"   = "Cleft Palate Repair",
  "craniofacial_recon"    = "Craniofacial Reconstruction",
  "breast_reconstruction" = "Breast Reconstruction",
  "cosmetic_surgery"      = "Cosmetic Surgery"
)

service_long <- df %>%
  select(all_of(procedure_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "procedure",
    values_to = "frequency"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frequency = str_squish(as.character(frequency)),
    frequency = case_when(
      str_to_lower(frequency) == "performed occasionally" ~
        "Occasionally performed",
      TRUE ~ frequency
    ),
    frequency = factor(
      frequency,
      levels = response_levels
    )
  )

```

```{r calculate_heatmap include=F}
# Calculate the heatmap percentages
heatmap_data <- service_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(frequency)) %>%
  count(procedure, frequency, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    procedure,
    frequency = factor(
      response_levels,
      levels = response_levels
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(procedure) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = if_else(
      total > 0,
      100 * n / total,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Order procedures by % routinely performed
procedure_order <- heatmap_data %>%
  filter(frequency == "routinely") %>%
  arrange(desc(percent)) %>%
  pull(procedure)

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(
    procedure = factor(
      procedure,
      levels = rev(procedure_order)
    )
  )


```

```{r create_heatmap echo=F}
# Creat heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = frequency, y = procedure, fill = percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(
    label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent),
    color = case_when(percent == 0 ~ "grey50", 
                      percent >= 50 ~ "white", 
                      TRUE ~ "black")
  ),
  size = 3.5,
  show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("white", RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = function(x)
      paste0(x, "%"),
    name = "Respondents (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Routinely", "Occasionally", "Rarely", "Not performed")) +
  labs(
    title = "Scope of Procedures Performed",
    subtitle = "Distribution of surgeon-reported procedural frequency",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Percentages calculated from valid responses",
      "for each procedure."
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      dplyr::coalesce(unname(procedure_labels[x]), x)
    }
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```

```{r join_lists include=F}
      "main_facility_name" = "facility_name"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"

```

```{r pivot include=F}
# Pivot long
service_long_country <- surgeon_service_country %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(procedure_vars),
    names_to = "procedure",
    values_to = "frequency"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frequency = factor(
      frequency,
      levels = response_levels,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

```

```{r calculate_percentage include=F}
# Calculate heatmap percentages by country
heatmap_country <- service_long_country %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    !is.na(procedure),
    !is.na(frequency)
  ) %>%
  count(
    facility_country,
    procedure,
    frequency,
    name = "n",
    .drop = FALSE
  ) %>%
  group_by(facility_country, procedure) %>%
  complete(
    frequency = factor(
      response_levels,
      levels = response_levels,
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = if_else(
      total > 0,
      100 * n / total,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(total > 0)

# Sort procedures by overall % routinely performed
# Only include respondents with a matched country
procedure_order <- service_long_country %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(facility_country),
    !is.na(procedure),
    !is.na(frequency)
  ) %>%
  group_by(procedure) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_routine = 100 * mean(
      frequency == "Routinely performed"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_routine)) %>%
  pull(procedure)

# Apply the same ordering to every country
heatmap_country <- heatmap_country %>%
  mutate(
    procedure = factor(
      as.character(procedure),
      levels = rev(procedure_order)
    ),
    frequency = factor(
      as.character(frequency),
      levels = response_levels,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

```


```{r create_heatmap echo=F}
# Function to create country-specific heatmaps
plot_country_heatmap <- function(country_name) {
  country_data <- heatmap_country %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name)
  
  if (nrow(country_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for", country_name))
  }
  
  # Count unique surgeons with at least one valid response
  n_surgeons <- service_long_country %>%
    filter(facility_country == country_name, !is.na(frequency)) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(id)) %>%
    pull(n)
  
  ggplot(country_data, aes(x = frequency, y = procedure, fill = percent)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(
      label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent),
      color = case_when(percent == 0 ~ "grey50", 
                        percent >= 50 ~ "white", 
                        TRUE ~ "black")
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("white", RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd")),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = function(x)
      paste0(x, "%"),
    name = "Respondents (%)"
  ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("Routinely", "Occasionally", "Rarely", "Not performed"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        dplyr::coalesce(unname(procedure_labels[x]), x)
      }
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Scope of Procedures Performed —", country_name),
      subtitle = "Surgeon-reported procedural frequency",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      caption = paste0("N = ", n_surgeons, " surgeons. ")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0,
        size = 9,
        color = "gray40"
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Get all countries
countries <- heatmap_country %>%
  distinct(facility_country) %>%
  pull(facility_country)

# Create an individual plot for every country
country_plots <- setNames(lapply(countries, plot_country_heatmap), countries)

# Display one country
print(country_plots[["Kenya"]])

# Define output directory
output_dir <- here("images", "country_heatmaps")

# Create folder if it doesn't exist
dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Save all country heatmaps
for (country in countries) {

  filename <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", country),
      "_heatmap.png"
    )
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = country_plots[[country]],
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

```

## Surgical Volume
